extension.description: The last mile of aiti-devtools: one-click dev server proxy injection + aiti-bridge lifecycle + automatic .vscode/mcp.json setup, so IDE built-in AI agents (Copilot Chat, etc.) can operate the page you are running.
command.enableDebug.title: aiti: Enable page debugging (inject + spawn bridge + configure MCP)
command.stopDebug.title: aiti: Stop debugging
command.openPanel.title: aiti: Open bridge panel
command.reinject.title: aiti: Re-inject (restart proxies; refresh the page to take effect)
setting.bridgePort.description: Port of the aiti-bridge standalone bridge (same default as the standalone bridge/systemd).
setting.bridgePath.description: Absolute path to aiti-bridge.mjs (leave empty to auto-detect: installed ~/.pi/web/node_modules/@aiti-ai/aiti-bridge → repo checkout packages/aiti-bridge).
setting.shimPath.description: Absolute path to aiti-mcp-shim.cjs (leave empty to auto-detect, same resolution order as bridgePath).
setting.proxyPort.description: Local reverse proxy listen port (opening this port in the browser = proxied dev server with injected HTML).
setting.targetUrl.description: Target dev server URL (leave empty = auto-scan common ports; can also be picked in the panel or via commands).
setting.aiUrl.description: AI window URL (leave empty = local bridge cockpit; may point to a pi-web instance, e.g. https://pi.example.com/ — the 💬 button in the page corner opens it).
setting.autoOpenBrowser.description: Automatically open the proxy URL (the injected page) after enabling debugging.
setting.autoEnable.description: Run "Enable page debugging" automatically on extension activation (workspace setting; for Extension Development Host automated tests / debug-as-soon-as-opened).
